description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code, Codex and other agents as an AI collaborator in your vault.
Free, open-source tiling window manager for Apple Silicon Macs, with Niri-style scrolling containers and Hyprland-style Dwindle BSP.
Atom Agent, Open-Source Governed AI Agent Platform for Self-Hosted Automation

Straightforward realtime kanban boards management for intuitive task tracking. 4ga Boards features an elegant dark mode, collapsible todo lists, and multitasking tools to supercharge your team's productivity.

Free, open-source, local-first dictation app for macOS. Hold a shortcut, speak, and text is typed into any app. On-device speech-to-text with Whisper, Parakeet and Apple speech. Private, offline, open-source Wispr Flow alternative.
本地优先的个人桌面效率工作台：时钟 / 倒计时 / 便签 / 待办 / 速记 / 速达 / AI 对话 / 剪贴板历史，所有数据本地存储、不上云端。基于 Tauri 2 + Vue 3 + TypeScript + Rust。

iPad-first, open-source iOS AI Agent with native on-device 3D/CAD editing, iPhone support and Android alpha. On-device Linux, terminal, Python/Node.js, Git and web previews; BYOK AI, Notes, Office, Canvas, voice, Skill Hub and supported local models on iOS. 开源设备端 AI 智能体工作台。
Your tasks, your server. An open-source, local-first task manager you can host yourself. Everything you expect from a commercial task app, without the subscription or the lock-in.

Termul is Terminal Ultimate Manager a cross-platform desktop terminal manager built with Tauri and React. Organize terminals by workspace with persistent sessions, multiple shell, split panes, embedded browser tabs, and a built-in code & markdown editor.
Tiling that feels like it shipped with macOS. Works out of the Box, settings menu, in-app updates, native Desktops kept intact, Lua underneath. Accessibility only, never SIP.
Chat with your Obsidian vault using your own Claude Code or Codex on desktop, or hosted AI. Edit notes with approval modes, transcribe audio and find related notes. Free to start.
The control plane for your AI employees

Claude Code on your laptop and remote dev boxes, in one web page. Sessions keep running when SSH drops (no tmux), each session's changes get their own diff, plus tasks, notes, and memory. Self-hosted.
A special mix of tools to help jump start your PowerShell session!
A calm, tidy design for Thunderbird on macOS, with colourful spaces, message cards and a clear calendar.
